descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your own basketball club, and nobody else is booked in.

A full-size hardwood court sits under a gabled steel roof, with afternoon sun coming through the clerestory windows and laying stripes across the boards. Real glass backboards. Real ten-foot rims. Painted lines measured off the rule book, bleachers down one side, banners in the rafters, and a members lounge behind the baseline.

SHOOTING THAT JUST WORKS
There is no shoot button. Pick up a ball, make the motion, and it releases itself at the top of your swing - exactly where a real shooter lets go. Backspin comes off your hand. The ball is a proper size seven with pebbled leather, and it bounces, rattles the rim and rings off the glass like the real thing. Five minutes in you stop thinking about the controller.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
FREE SHOOT - no clock. Twenty balls on the carts, both baskets live, shoot until you feel like stopping.
SHOOTOUT - sixty seconds. Twos inside the arc, threes outside, one number to beat.
THREE POINT - five racks around the arc, four balls on each, and the last ball on every rack is worth double.
AROUND THE WORLD - seven spots, in order. Make one to move on. Your fastest lap is kept.

Scores, the clock and your personal best hang over the backboard where a shot clock goes, so you never look away from the rim. Pick a track from the in-game menu and shoot to it.

Standing or roomscale. Pick it up for five minutes or an hour.
